name: childhood_schedule_v1_draft
revised: 2026-09-10 (review): reasoning_gym-only shares — the deployment gym (compiler) is the unseen final test (IDEAS 2026-09-10 late, Decision 1) and never a childhood environment; stage 2's vacuous family_accuracy_min 0.0 removed until a frozen noise band exists
status: DRAFT for Rohin's signature (design 3.8 uses LockGym / rule game v2; the only trait gym built today is reasoning_gym, so every stage names it; a gym missing from a stage's shares plays min_batches)
notes: Shares are WAKE BATCHES per clone per round (sleep); a clone plays shares[gym] * wake_batch episodes per round (4 x 8 = 32, today's --sleep-every). Exit criteria are computed and LOGGED at every sleep from the stage's last window_sleeps sleeps (curriculum.exit_check); they are NOT enforced yet. Stage 2's accuracy criterion (design: 1 - Brier up by >= 1 band SD) needs the D1 frozen-model band and is deliberately absent from this draft.

stages.name: 1_persistence
stages.trait: keep working a hard problem; re-plan after failure; many changing attempts; never quit early

stages.name: 2_prediction_calibration
stages.trait: predictions tied to a named feature; honest confidence; surprise treated as evidence

stages.name: 3_exploration
stages.trait: one deliberate deviation when the default has repeated; change the hypothesis when the evidence contradicts it
